description.p: Soplos Look Manager changes how Soplos Linux Tyson looks, from one window: the global theme, the wallpaper, the icons, the cursors, the GTK theme, the panels, the start-up screen and the login screen.

Soplos Look Manager cambia el aspecto de Soplos Linux Tyson desde una sola ventana: el tema global, el fondo, los iconos, los cursores, el tema GTK, los paneles, la pantalla de arranque y la de inicio de sesión.

Soplos Look Manager change l'apparence de Soplos Linux Tyson depuis une seule fenêtre : le thème global, le fond d'écran, les icônes, les curseurs, le thème GTK, les panneaux, l'écran de démarrage et l'écran de connexion.

Soplos Look Manager ändert das Aussehen von Soplos Linux Tyson in einem einzigen Fenster: das globale Thema, den Hintergrund, die Symbole, die Zeiger, das GTK-Thema, die Leisten, den Startbildschirm und den Anmeldebildschirm.
O Soplos Look Manager altera o aspeto do Soplos Linux Tyson numa só janela: o tema global, o fundo, os ícones, os cursores, o tema GTK, os painéis, o ecrã de arranque e o de início de sessão.
Soplos Look Manager cambia l'aspetto di Soplos Linux Tyson da un'unica finestra: il tema globale, lo sfondo, le icone, i cursori, il tema GTK, i pannelli, la schermata di avvio e quella di accesso.
Soplos Look Manager schimbă aspectul Soplos Linux Tyson dintr-o singură fereastră: tema globală, fundalul, pictogramele, cursoarele, tema GTK, panourile, ecranul de pornire și cel de autentificare.
Soplos Look Manager меняет внешний вид Soplos Linux Tyson из одного окна: глобальную тему, обои, значки, курсоры, тему GTK, панели, экран запуска и экран входа.

description.p: First stable release. Every page was tried on a Plasma desktop, the window behavior and the window rules included, and the program comes with its manual page.

First beta. The Windows group is complete: virtual desktops, window behavior, window rules, desktop effects, KWin scripts and the task switcher. What the pages list can be installed from the store of KDE or from a file, and removed, and the sections of the sidebar fold.

Every wallpaper has its own card with its picture, kept in a small copy so the list scrolls smoothly, and the icon, cursor and GTK themes show what they look like. Applying a global theme asks what to apply, as System Settings does: the appearance, and the layout of the desktop and the panels. The cursor themes that cannot be applied and the GTK themes with no appearance are not offered. The panels have the options of Plasma (alignment, width, offset, opacity) and a dock style, and a new panel can be an empty one. The pages of the Global theme of System Settings that were missing are there: colors, application style, Plasma style, window decorations and sounds. New pages for virtual desktops, desktop effects, KWin scripts and the task switcher, the sections of the sidebar fold, and what is listed can be installed from the store of KDE or from a file, and removed.
First version. Global themes, wallpapers, icon themes, cursor themes, GTK themes, panels, start-up screen and the login screen of Plasma Login Manager. Not yet tested on a Plasma desktop.
